developerProfile.legalEntity: Two related legal entities identified. Wheeler & Brand Lda (NIF 514103825, AMI 12874) is the real estate intermediation business, registered at Rua Sacadura Cabral, 262 R/C Dto. B, 8135-144 Almancil, operating for approximately 9 years. Brand & Wheeler-Brand Lda (NIF 517615576) is a separate entity incorporated on 12 June 2023 at the same address, with CAE 68120 (building development) and declared capital of 1–5,000 EUR; this entity appears to be the vehicle for development projects including The V. A UK office also operates from 6 Stone Street Court, Hadleigh, Suffolk, IP7 6DN.
developerProfile.previousProjects: No. 22 Beach House (Fonte Santa) — single house, described as complete and available for sale. No. 25 Vale do Lobo (five-bedroom villa at the Village development, under construction as of last available data, targeted early 2025 completion). Pipeline: Villa B Almancil (single villa, construction planned 2025), VDG Houses (two villas, construction planned early 2025), Luxurious Townhomes (four townhouses near Vale do Lobo, rooftop pools), Fonte Residences (eleven villa residences), Fonte Townhouses (twenty-five townhouse residences). The V Apartments is the developer's first multi-unit apartment project. Robert Brand also founded Golden Triangle Properties (rentals) in 2002, described as one of the largest rental companies in the Algarve.
developerProfile.trackRecordSummary: Wheeler & Brand's confirmed delivered portfolio consists of single-house residential projects in the Golden Triangle. The V represents their first attempt at a multi-unit apartment development. No financial delivery track record for an apartment scheme of this scale has been established. No disputes, buyer complaints, or financial distress found in searches. No financial partners or lenders disclosed publicly.
developerProfile.knownIssues: No disputes or delivery failures found. The development entity (Brand & Wheeler-Brand Lda) was incorporated in June 2023 with minimal declared capital; it has no prior project delivery history as a legal entity. The architect credit (David Sinclair Arquitectos Associados) is unconfirmed in the firm's own accessible portfolio.

marketPosition.priceComparison: The implied price per m² of approximately €10,815/sqm for the entry 2-bedroom unit (92 sqm at €995,000) sits materially above the Vale do Lobo flat average of €7,250/sqm recorded in February 2025, and is broadly aligned with Quinta do Lago's average of €11,170/sqm as of February 2026. The pricing positions The V at the upper end of the Almancil-Ferrarias submarket, closer to Quinta do Lago benchmarks despite the site being in Ferrarias rather than within either resort boundary.
marketPosition.investmentNarrative: The development is positioned as a premium Golden Triangle residential product with resort-adjacent amenity (3 km from Vale do Lobo and Quinta do Lago golf courses and beaches). The developer's existing rental management business (Golden Triangle Properties, est. 2002) creates a natural lettings pathway for buyers. No rental yield projections, comparables, or transaction-based evidence has been publicly disclosed.
marketPosition.buyerSegment: International second-home and investment buyers drawn to the Algarve Golden Triangle; likely British and northern European given the developer's UK presence and the area's established international buyer base. Buyers with budgets between €1M and €3M seeking resort-proximity living with managed services.
marketPosition.demandDrivers: Golden Triangle location between Quinta do Lago and Vale do Lobo — the Algarve's highest-priced residential submarket. Faro International Airport 20 minutes by car (~21 km). Vale do Lobo resort (established early 1960s, 400 hectares) offers two par-72 golf courses (Royal and Ocean, designed by Sir Henry Cotton), Royal Spa, and 14-court tennis academy. Area records over 300 days of sunshine annually. Access via A22 motorway and EN125 national road; Loulé train station approximately 4 km north.

designSignals.architecturalStyle: Developer describes 'timeless architecture' as the design language. David Sinclair Arquitectos Associados (listed as the architect) has a background in hospitality and resort residential in the Algarve, including collaboration on Vilamoura projects (Victoria Residences, As Cascatas Hilton Hotel). The firm's accessible portfolio does not include The V. The precise architectural character of the building (contemporary, classical, modernist) cannot be established from publicly available materials.
designSignals.materials: Stone and wood named as primary natural materials on the official site. Bespoke kitchens and handcrafted cabinetry by Edwin Loxley (operating as Loxley Kitchens Algarve). Interior packages offered via Pure Allure Interior, an official Flexform and Casamilano dealer for Portugal.
designSignals.landscaping: THE Park communal landscape: pine parkland with Mediterranean planting, native species, water conservation focus. Features include a walking track, yoga platform, herb garden, fruit trees, and a sports zone. Jardim Vista (Almancil, founded 1990 by Richard Westcott, BSc Horticulture & Landscape Design, Reading University; self-described as largest landscaping firm in the Iberian Peninsula, 250+ team members, operations across Portugal and internationally) is listed as landscape partner on thev.pt.
designSignals.visualIdentity: Brand identity and digital presence designed by KOBU Agência Criativa Digital (Faro, 2024), including custom typeface design. The project name and visual language position it as a discreet premium residential product rather than a resort-branded scheme.

pressReleases.title: THE V branding: luxury real estate in the Algarve
pressReleases.summary: KOBU Agency published a case study on their branding work for The V Apartments. The piece details brand strategy, custom typeface design, and digital content production undertaken by the Faro-based creative agency for the 20-unit Golden Triangle development.

pressReleases.title: THE V Apartments - Exceptional Living
pressReleases.summary: Golden Triangle Properties' dedicated listing page for The V details pricing for all unit types (€995,000 to €2,995,000), the 20-apartment configuration, penthouses with rooftop pools, THE Park amenity, concierge, underground parking and 24-hour security.

pressReleases.title: Two bed luxury apartment at THE V near Quinta do Lago
pressReleases.summary: Mapro Real Estate lists a 2-bedroom, 3-bathroom apartment at The V (92 sqm gross build area, €995,000) with a May 2027 completion date and Energy Class A rating. The listing details bespoke kitchen, private terrace, pool access, underground parking and concierge.
